name: Normies Paths
description: Returns 3–5 Pulse-weighted ranked paths for any Normie agent. Call after Normies Cred Pulse. Designed for autonomous agent-to-agent and NFT-to-NFT decision making. Token-gated to Normie holders.

intent.description: Short free-text intent (e.g. 'efficient burn fodder', 'canvas evolution'). Provide intent or intentTag.

intentTag.description: Structured intent chip. Provide intent or intentTag.

tokenId.description: Subject Normie token ID whose Pulse conditions the ranking

wallet.description: Optional caller wallet for access enrichment

intent.description: Parsed intent with tags and primary chip

subject.description: Subject Normie Pulse snapshot used for ranking (level, status, gaps)

paths.description: Ranked paths (3–5). Each includes pathId, title, publisher, Pulse badge, access note, score breakdown, rationale, and concrete nextStep

payments.description: Payment status (planned until A2A rails live)
